en: Black-and-white view of a small railway station named BOHUS. Wooden station buildings stand beside multiple electrified railway tracks with overhead wires and masts in the foreground. A truck is parked near the entrance, a few people sit and stand on the platform, and low wooded hills rise behind the station. The layout, signage, and vehicles suggest a mid-20th-century European setting.
